outcome: Apgar score less than 7 at 5 minutes
childhood development (gross and fine motor function, communication, and social functioning) at 2 years
cohort: 435,281 singleton live births in Scotland between 2007 and 2016
finding: Labor epidural analgesia was not independently associated with adverse neonatal or childhood development outcomes.
mod_finding: Associations between epidural analgesia and neonatal resuscitation and admission were likely mediated by mode of delivery.
